free_tier.stated: none reachable: the Microsoft Learn overview page returned a not-found status on a probe; the first-party product page describes published datasets with no sign-up or intake form and states storage is free while egress may be charged to the accessing subscription.

per_object_cap.stated: stated-absent: the Azure Open Datasets product page states no per-object size cap.

retention.stated: stated-absent: the Azure Open Datasets product page states no retention term for the published datasets; Microsoft states no SLA or availability guarantee for them.

egress.terms: Azure Open Datasets: "Microsoft pays for the storage costs associated with hosting Azure Open Datasets. While storage will always remain free, egress costs associated with reading large datasets can be charged to the Azure subscription accessing the data."

interface_detail: Azure Open Datasets are read from Azure Blob Storage through an SDK; the page states "Learn how datasets are stored in Azure and accessed using an SDK." No single interface token covers SDK-on-Blob access, so rest is the nearest term.
chaining: Azure Open Datasets: "Deliver insights at hyperscale using Azure Open Datasets with Azure's machine learning and data analytics solutions." Datasets are read-only inputs, not a writable deposit target.
